description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
 We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
 Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Creative Frontend Developer to help build visually engaging, interactive, and responsive web experiences across Bask Health's platform.
 This role combines frontend engineering with creative development and strong attention to design. You'll work closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to transform visual concepts into polished, functional websites and application interfaces.
 You'll develop responsive layouts, interactive components, animations, and reusable frontend elements that improve how merchants and users experience Bask's software. Your work may include merchant-facing websites, customizable storefronts, product interfaces, and other digital experiences that require a balance of visual quality and technical performance.
 This position is ideal for someone who enjoys the creative side of frontend development but also understands the importance of clean code, maintainable architecture, accessibility, and performance.
 You'll contribute throughout the development process, from exploring design concepts and building prototypes to implementing production features, troubleshooting issues, and refining user interactions.
 We're looking for someone who cares about visual details, enjoys collaborating with designers, and can turn ambitious ideas into high-quality web experiences that are both attractive and practical.
 What You'll Do
 Build visually polished and responsive websites and frontend interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
 Translate design concepts and Figma files into production-ready web experiences.
 Develop engaging animations, transitions, and interactive interface elements.
 Create reusable frontend components that support consistent design and functionality.
 Build responsive layouts that work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
 Develop merchant-facing website components and customizable storefront experiences.
 Implement interactive elements that improve navigation, usability, and engagement.
 Collaborate closely with designers to refine visual details and interaction behavior.
 Develop reusable animation patterns and motion components.
 Build interactive landing pages and product experiences.
 Support the development of website templates and configurable page sections.
 Implement smooth scrolling effects, hover interactions, and page transitions where appropriate.
 Maintain consistent typography, spacing, colors, and visual hierarchy across interfaces.
 Work with product teams to understand user experience goals and design requirements.
 Integrate frontend components with APIs and existing application functionality.
 Improve frontend performance, rendering efficiency, and loading behavior.
 Optimize images, fonts, and other visual assets for web performance.
 Ensure responsive behavior and compatibility across modern browsers.
 Support accessibility improvements and appropriate reduced-motion behavior.
 Develop prototypes to explore new design concepts and interactive features.
 Help maintain and improve frontend design systems and component libraries.
 Write clean, maintainable, and well-structured frontend code.
 Test interactive functionality and troubleshoot visual or behavioral issues.
 Participate in code reviews and contribute to frontend engineering best practices.
 Collaborate with engineers to integrate creative components into existing applications.
 Identify opportunities to improve visual consistency and user experience.
 Take ownership of assigned creative development projects from concept through deployment and maintenance.
 Requirements 
 
 3+ years of professional experience in frontend development, creative development, design engineering, or a comparable role.
 Strong professional experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
 Experience developing modern web applications using React.
 Familiarity with Next.js or comparable frontend frameworks.
 Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive web design.
 Experience translating visual designs into functional web interfaces.
 Strong understanding of layout, typography, spacing, and visual consistency.
 Experience building interactive frontend components and user interfaces.
 Experience implementing web animations, transitions, and interactive effects.
 Familiarity with modern CSS techniques and component styling approaches.
 Understanding of reusable frontend component architecture.
 Experience developing responsive interfaces for different screen sizes and devices.
 Strong attention to detail when implementing designs.
 Familiarity with browser rendering behavior and cross-browser compatibility.
 Experience optimizing frontend performance and loading behavior.
 Understanding of web accessibility and usability principles.
 Experience working with Git and collaborative development workflows.
 Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-organized frontend code.
 Experience debugging frontend layout, styling, and interaction issues.
 Familiarity with frontend testing and quality assurance practices.
 Experience collaborating with designers, product managers, and engineers.
 Ability to interpret design requirements and recommend practical implementation approaches.
 Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to independently manage assigned features and development tasks.
 Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with GSAP, Framer Motion, or comparable animation libraries.
 Familiarity with scroll-driven animations and interactive storytelling.
 Experience building highly interactive marketing websites or landing pages.
 Experience with Tailwind CSS or modern styling systems.
 Familiarity with reusable design systems and component libraries.
 Experience developing configurable website templates or page builders.
 Experience with Shopify storefronts or other e-commerce website platforms.
 Familiarity with white-label or merchant-facing SaaS applications.
 Experience with advanced CSS animations and transitions.
 Familiarity with SVG animation or Canvas-based effects.
 Experience with Three.js or WebGL for lightweight interactive elements.
 Experience with design tools such as Figma.
 Familiarity with image optimization and responsive asset delivery.
 Experience with frontend performance monitoring and Core Web Vitals.
 Experience with frontend testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.
 Familiarity with accessibility considerations for animated interfaces.
 Experience building reusable motion or interaction libraries.
 Experience collaborating on brand-focused digital experiences.
 Experience with content management systems or structured content models.
 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
